newsitem.title: USA: Boston Scientific says Q2 sales $474 mln.
newsitem.headline: Boston Scientific says Q2 sales $474 mln.

text.p: Boston Scientific Corp said Monday net sales for the second quarter ended June 30 increased 25 percent to $474 million compared to $379 million in the second quarter of 1996.
The company said international revenues for the quarter were impacted by changes in foreign currency exchange rates.
Without the impact of changes in exchange rates, net sales for the second quarter increased 28 percent.
The company said reported revenues include the combined net sales of Boston Scientific Corp and Target Therapeutics Inc TGET.O to reflect the merger consummated during the second quarter.
The company said revenue growth in the quarter was in line with its expectations.
The company said it expects to release complete financial results for the second quarter later in July.
Boston Scientific makes and sells medical devices.
